name: T6713 CO2 sensor
description: Amphenol Telaire NDIR carbon dioxide sensor module, 0-2000 ppm (T6713-5K: 0-5000 ppm), +/-30 ppm +/-3 % of reading, new reading every 5 s. Speaks Modbus over I2C (address 0x15, 100 kHz) when its CTRL pin is grounded, plus a PWM output. Needs a 4.5-5.5 V supply (about 25 mA average, 200 mA peaks). Sold as: Amphenol Telaire T6713 module (bare 30 x 20 mm board, 6-hole 2.54 mm header: SDA, SCL, VCC, GND, PWM, CTRL), I2C address 0x15.
eli5: Measures how much carbon dioxide is in the room, so you can tell when it is stuffy and needs fresh air.

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: Pin 1: I2C data (UART TX in UART mode). Has an internal 4.7 kOhm pull-up inside the sensor.

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: Pin 2: I2C clock (UART RX in UART mode). No internal pull-up: needs an external 4.7 kOhm pull-up, to 3.3 V on a 3.3 V board.

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Pin 3 (V+): supply 4.5-5.5 V; peaks of 200 mA when the lamp fires

pins.name: PWM
pins.description: Pin 5: PWM output (25 kHz in I2C mode), needs its own pull-up; not needed for I2C use

pins.name: CTRL
pins.description: Pin 6: interface select. Tie to GND to select I2C (left open = UART). Max 3 V on this pin.

supplierQuery: Amphenol Telaire T6713 CO2 sensor module
buildNotes: Tie pin 6 (CTRL) to GND before power-up: the sensor picks I2C or UART only at start-up from this pin.
Power it from 5 V (4.5-5.5 V), not 3.3 V. It draws 200 mA peaks, so put a 10-100 uF capacitor across VCC/GND near the sensor.
SCL needs an external 4.7 kOhm pull-up (SDA has one inside the sensor). The I2C pins work with 3.3 V logic.
Read CO2: write 04 13 8B 00 01, wait 5-10 ms, read 4 bytes 04 02 MSB LSB; ppm = MSB * 256 + LSB. No CRC on I2C.
The sensor uses I2C clock stretching and only runs at 100 kHz; use hardware I2C at 100 kHz.
Readings settle after 2 minutes (full accuracy after 10 minutes); status bit 0x0800 means it is still warming up.
ABC Logic self-calibrates assuming the room sees fresh air (400 ppm) at least once a week.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from t6713 import T6713

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=100000)
sensor = T6713(i2c)
while True:
    print('CO2=%d ppm' % sensor.co2())
    time.sleep(2)
